verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch is a data service, so scoped agent credentials are a fair question. Only community comments touch the topic: one mentions fine-grained access control as a proprietary add-on, and another says X-Pack security (login/auth) became free in v7. Neither shows that users can issue scoped API keys. Missing for 10: first-party docs on creating API keys, per-key role or index privilege scoping, expiry/revocation, and any agent-specific credential guidance or hands-on corroboration.
